title: 5 stars!! Highly customizable!!
body: I have been trying so many different apps to develop routines that will motivate me and keep me on track. This app is perfect for that to me!  I love that I can mix a timed activity with checklist items since there are times I just want to check off an activity without setting a time duration.  I have not found that feature in other apps that I have tried and this feature is very beneficial to me!  I love the flexibility that I can change the order of the activities within the routine and that I can customize my routines with different colors and icons!  I have developed many different custom designed routines using these features. The user interface is nicely designed and intuitive to set up customized designs and routines. This meets my needs and I am enjoying this beautifully customizable app to structure my day!!
author: margo79
